request.description: This endpoint was paginated, the pageSize should have a value of 10 instead of 2, I used 2 because the total data count wasnt up to 11 and i needed to see if the second page works

### Request Body Documentation

"type" field should be implemented as search shortcuts. TheoOptions in Enum "type" include: 'swallow', 'soup', 'snacks', 'rice', 'others'.

This endpoint is for both the search meals by title and quick search by type.

The date entered in the query parameter should be in YYYY-MM-DD format, else it throws an error as seen in the example response named invalid time value.

This endpoint doubles for get all budgets and search budgets by filter
